errors.evidence: The description states that the Bulgaria line has a dip to approximately 1,700 around 1995. However, the chart shows this dip occurs around 1997. In 1995, the value is significantly higher, at approximately 2,200.

errors.text_span: От 2000 г. до около 2008 г. светлосинята линия отбелязва постоянен спад до ниво от около 1 100
errors.evidence: The description claims the Bulgaria line drops to a level of about 1,100 by 2008. According to the chart, the value in 2008 is approximately 1,200. The value of 1,100 is reached later, around 2013-2014.

errors.text_span: най-ниска точка от приблизително 750 в средата на 90-те години
errors.evidence: The description states that the OECD line reaches its lowest point of approximately 750 in the mid-90s. The chart shows this minimum value is reached later, around the year 2000, not in the middle of the 1990s.
